what_happened.line: The committee accepted the manager's report and the March, April and May financials, each by unanimous roll call.
A motion to let the manager get a Dropbox subscription for the station and videographers was made, but the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
The Castus drive array failed, and replacement drives bought by IT are being paid through purchase requisitions.
Two COVID-19 costs, the Castus stream fee and a laptop for remote recordings, are being submitted for state reimbursement.
The manager will offer the third educational channel to the superintendent for school online content and keep pressing Comcast.

why_it_matters: The station is paid from cable franchise revenue, so a lower Comcast payment, unplanned equipment repairs and remote-meeting costs all affect what is left for local programming and Town Meeting coverage.
Whether the Dropbox purchase was approved is not clear from the record, so residents cannot tell from these minutes if that recurring cost was authorized.
